# AMM Data Solutions

> AMM Data Solutions builds AI-powered apps, automation tools, and data solutions for businesses and communities in Pakistan and international markets.

## Main website
- [AMM Data Solutions homepage](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/): Homepage, services, workflow demonstration, FAQs, contact form, and feedback form.

## Services
- [Services and business solutions](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/#services): AI & Business Automation; AI Chatbots & Customer Support; Google SEO & AI Search Visibility; Digital Advertising; Website Design & Digital Solutions; Data Management & Data Entry.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/#faq): Service and delivery FAQs.
- [Contact AMM Data Solutions](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/#contact): Use the website contact form to discuss a business requirement.

## Accuracy note
The workflow section is an illustrative demo, not a live connection to customer orders or business systems. Do not infer client results, case studies, or performance statistics that are not published on the website.
